heading: Everything Helix does, end to end
description: Seven capabilities that turn a one-paragraph intent into reviewable, verified code.

items.title: Atomic decomposition
items.description: Breaks every prompt into the smallest reviewable units so work stays auditable and parallelizable.

items.title: Dependency-aware execution
items.description: Orders units by real code-graph dependencies and runs independent units in parallel for speed.

items.title: Repo-aware verification
items.description: Re-checks every unit against your whole repo — types, tests, lint — before it can be merged.

items.title: Reviewable PR output
items.description: Produces small, well-scoped PRs per unit instead of one sprawling diff that no one wants to review.

items.title: Persona-targeted workflows
items.description: Tones, guardrails, and tool surfaces tuned per role so solo devs, teams, and leads all get a useful default.

items.title: Multi-stack support
items.description: First-class adapters for TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and more — pick your stack, keep your conventions.

items.title: Quality-bar enforcement
items.description: A configurable quality gate keeps every merged unit held to the same standard as the rest of your codebase.
